instruction.name: xvmaddwod.q.du
instruction.description: Multiply the odd-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding unsigned 64-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 128-bit, and add the product to the 128-bit elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 6.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmaddwod.q.du $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvmaddwod.q.du $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
